{{DISPLAYTITLE:User blog:Keeper0crypt/Numerical & Allegorical Theories}} == Numerical & Allegorical Theories relating to the Liber Primus == >>> NOTE: work in progress. === Introduction === I have been fascinated by 3301 since it began. I never attempted solving it, and subsequently forgot about it. Then it entered my path again when I was researching blockchain and related currency. I believe the Liber Primus reflects the work of a group that has profound knowledge of both science and gnosticism. The connections between the concepts reflect a clear narrative, one that aligns perfectly with some of the hermetic societies that are still around today. This would also explain the geographical separation of their operatives. It seems new discoveries borne out from the text are far and few between now that all the "traditional" cryptographic tasks have been completed. I strongly believe we cannot solve this puzzle if we focus purely on ciphers and codebreaking methods without taking into account notions of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rosicrucianism rosicrucianism] and creative use of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Combinatorics combinatorics]. A number of things related to wording used in the decoded pages, linked to concepts from rosicrucianism, suggest to me a shadow of an idea of the techniques might have been used to obfuscate the remaining Liber Primus pages. This document serves as a document of my attempt to bring that shadow into the light. None of my theory has been tested. And by no means do I profess any sort of mathematical prowess. What is stated here is to be considered pure conjecture, until proven or disproven. By me or others. As I have next to no mathematical education, little religious awareness and so I have to study and teach myself as I go along. I am currently learning how to build some of the algorithms in the Julia programming language and hope to make progress once my mathematical understanding deepens. I am of middle age so my learning pace and insight is low. This is a working document and I will update my findings and musing here. Please comment if you have feedback. I will discuss the following topics: # Analysis of matrices found and their relation to other findings; # Finite state automata; # Collatz sequences; # Elliptic Curves (specifically the Sato–Tate conjecture); # Moebius Transformation.
=== 1. Analysis of matrices === There are two 5x5 matrices that contain a prime number at the center. An integer sequence is mirrored about the prime number in both cases. These matrices have been used by others as magic squares previously to solve some onion related puzzles. But there seems to be a lot more to them. This chapter is devoted to discovering as much as I can about their allegoric and formulaic structure as I can.
==== 1.1 Table 1 ==== 272 138 341 131 151 366 199 130 320 18 226 245 91 245 226 18 320 130 199 366 151 131 341 138 272 -- [https://github.com/scream314/cicada3301/blob/master/assets/2014/liber-primus-complete/05.jpg Chapter 1, Page 5] This table was derived by others from the original which contained words: 272 138 "SHADOWS" 131 151 "AETHEREAL" "BUFFERS" "VOID" "CARNAL" 18 226 "OBSCURA" "FORM" 245 "MOBIUS" 18 "ANALOG" "VOID" "MOURNFUL" "AETHEREAL" 151 131 "CABAL" 138 272 The words in this matrix seem to convey a lot of information about the sections in the book. I will discuss my findings in the following sections.
===== 1.1.1 AETHERIAL ===== This is highly likely concerned with pages image of the man lying on his back. The man is most probably [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollonius_of_Rhodes Apollonius of Rhodes], who wrote about Jason and the Argonauts and their quest for the holy fleece, another word for the holy Grail to which many references are made by 3301. Apollonius is said to have ascended and the backstory on how he first began his quest towards that ascension is:
...the descent of Balinas (the Arabic Apollonius of Tyana) to acquire the Emerald Table of Hermes, along with variant narratives, blended the motif of an initiatory ascension with the motif, found in Egyptian and Hellenistic tales, of '''''the discovery of a book in a subterranean chamber'''''.
-- http://esoteric.msu.edu/Merkur.html It is not a coincidence that we have found our own book containing promises of ascension in a subterranean chamber (the Deep Web). Historians believe there are many similarities between the life of Apollonius and the mythical "Tristan". Take a look at a cutout of Bill Viola's "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gqf_cuDf9qI Tristan's Ascension]" next to the image of the man lying down: {| class="article-table" ![[File:Man lying down.png|thumb]] ![[File:Tristan's Ascension.jpg|left|thumb]] |} Clearly one is styled after the other. If there are any students of classic art reading, please tell me if such an image exists outside of 3301 and Bill Viola. If not, it looks like 3301 took Bill's work as a template. Now for Tristan to ascend, he has to go through/towards the "buffer": [[File:Tristan & buffer.png|thumb|alt=|none]] Also note that the man is now oriented the same way as Tristan in Bill Viola's piece, possibly indicating he is ready for ascension. ===== 1.1.2 BUFFERS ===== The Oxford dictionary describes "buffer" as:
A person or thing that reduces a shock or that forms a barrier between incompatible or antagonistic people or things.
This sounds to me like a Christ figure, who died on the cross at a place called Golgotha. According to liturgy, christ served as a "buffer" of sorts between the unknowable God and the Kingdom of Earth. Presumably this word refers to the Golgotha crosses found on various pages (In the order they are encountered): {| class="article-table" ![[File:Cross 2.png|left|thumb]] ![[File:Cross 1.png|left|thumb]] ![[File:Cross 3.png|left|thumb]] |} Note that this is the canonical representation of such a cross (A Russian Orthodox Golgotha Cross, wikipedia): [[File:Russian Golgotha cross.png|thumb|alt=|none]] None of the crosses in the document adhere to the canonical representation. All of them have been flipped and/or rotated along some of their axes, so it appears that the images encode a sequence of geometric translations. Also note that all buffers have three dots on one side and that these seem to have been added on purpose given the whitespace around them: {| class="article-table" ![[File:Cross 1 dots.png|left|thumb]] ![[File:Cross 2 dots.png|left|thumb]] |} It does not seem that the dots in the horizontally aligned cross image adhere to those on the vertically aligned ones. However it might give us some information on what operations were applied to transform one of the vertically aligned crosses to the horizontally aligned one. In other words it may be a riddle of the type "A is to B as B is to C", very pythagorean.. Finally, the "distorted" horizontally aligned cross has an additional 3 dots: [[File:Additional dots.png|thumb|alt=|none]] There are patterns of dots throughout the document. The first is on Page 24, and the three dots there line up with the three dots on the "distorted" cross. There are other places where we find dots: {| class="article-table" !Page 24 !Page 40 !Page 50 !Page 56 |- ![[File:Page 24.png|left|thumb]] ![[File:Page 40.png|left|thumb]] ![[File:Page 50.png|left|thumb]] ![[File:Page 56.png|left|thumb]] |} These translations of the cross images and the translations of the dots images about their axes in 3d space seem to follow a similar principle. The dots on page 50 and 56 line up perfectly with one another, but not with the notches on the crosses or the dots next to them: [[File:Dots 50 - 56 - crosses.png|thumb|alt=|none]] The aligned dots do line up with the notches on the crosses to some degree, but not perfectly. '''TODO:''' # Distill some basic quantities and relationships to establish what rules are at play; # Perhaps we get some new information if we manipulate the this cross such that the three dots on the side of it line up with the other triplets; # Try to match the different "constellations" of dots to the crosses, and look at some combinations of image data. 1.1.3 OBSCURA 1.1.4 ANALOG 1.1.5 SHADOWS 1.1.6 FORM 1.1.7 CABAL 1.1.8 CARNAL
